name: Version History
content:
Version History lets you save named snapshots of your project as you work. If you break something, you can restore an earlier version that was working.

---

## Where to find it

Version History is a tab in the **Resource Panel** on the left side of Web Lab.

---

## Saving a version

Save a version whenever your project is in a working state, especially before making large changes.

**1. Open the Version History tab**
Click the Version History tab in the Resource Panel.

**2. Write a short description**
Add a note describing what's working in this version — for example: *"Navigation bar done"* or *"Contact form added."* This makes it easier to find the right version later.

**3. Click "Save current version"**
This saves a snapshot of your project as it is right now.

**4. Confirm**
Click save. The version is stored and will appear in your version list.

---

## Browsing saved versions

In the Version History tab, you'll see a list of all saved versions:

- Each entry shows the description you wrote and a timestamp.
- **AI-generated versions** are saved automatically when AI Tutor makes changes — these are marked with an AI label.
- Click any version to preview what your project looked like at that point.

---

## Restoring a version

**1. Open the Version History tab**

**2. Click the version you want**
This shows a preview of that version.

**3. Click "Restore"**
Your project will revert to that version. Your current unsaved changes will be replaced, so make sure you're restoring the right one.

---

## Version History and AI Tutor

When AI Tutor makes changes to your code, it will prompt you to save a version before continuing. This means:

- You have a checkpoint before any AI changes take effect.
- If you don't like the result, you can restore your previous version.

---
